Wing Commander Abhinandan Varthaman Departs Indian Air Force

Wing Commander Abhinandan Varthaman, who was captured by Pakistan during the Balakot airstrike and held for 60 hours, has departed the Indian Air Force. He was known for his role in shooting down a Pakistani jet. Questions have been raised about the rules governing his ability to fly private jets following his departure from the service.
